projectInfo.name: Overland Baseball Website
projectInfo.description: Baseball team website with admin features, events, roster management, and theme customization

techStack.styling: Material-UI v5 with extensive custom theme

namingConventions.files: PascalCase for components, camelCase for utilities

layoutPatterns.pageStructure: Hero (optional, full-width) + Container + Grid for main content
layoutPatterns.contentGrid: Grid container with responsive columnSpacing using useMediaQueries

TextBlock.purpose: Flexible layout wrapper using MUI Stack - replaces manual flex/text styling
TextBlock.usage: Use as a container for any content that needs flex positioning - ALWAYS prefer this over raw divs or manual flex styling
TextBlock.notes: Simple wrapper around MUI Stack - use this for consistent spacing and layout patterns

SectionLayout.purpose: Standardized section spacing and margins with responsive breakpoints
SectionLayout.usage: Wrap all page sections with this component for consistent spacing throughout the site
SectionLayout.notes: Provides consistent 4rem->8rem margins across breakpoints, use for all major page sections

StyledSectionLayoutWrapper.purpose: Enhanced SectionLayout with gray background styling for highlighted sections
StyledSectionLayoutWrapper.usage: Use when you need a section with a distinctive gray background wrapper - extends SectionLayout functionality
StyledSectionLayoutWrapper.notes: Provides light gray background (#f8f9fa), padding, rounded corners (20px), and subtle border. Built on top of SectionLayout component

SectionHeader.purpose: Consistent header pattern with title, subtitle, and optional CTA
SectionHeader.usage: Use for all section headings instead of manual Typography combinations
SectionHeader.example: <SectionHeader title='Our Team' subtitle='meet the players' cta={button} />
SectionHeader.notes: Includes TextBlock internally, provides uppercase subtitle styling and flex layout

SocialIcons.purpose: Reusable social media icons component with customizable theming and responsive behavior
SocialIcons.usage: Use for displaying social media links with consistent styling and hover effects - preferred over manual icon implementations
SocialIcons.notes: Includes default Facebook/Instagram/Twitter icons, supports theme color notation (e.g., 'secondary.main'), responsive margin with useMediaQueries, flexible icon array with name/icon/link structure

Container.purpose: MUI Container for main page content with semantic HTML
Container.usage: Use Container component='main' with semantic id and aria-label for all main page content
Container.notes: Standard pattern for main content areas, provides consistent padding via theme overrides

Grid.purpose: MUI Grid system with responsive spacing using useMediaQueries
Grid.usage: Use Grid container with columnSpacing based on useMediaQueries breakpoints
Grid.notes: Standard spacing pattern: isLg ? 6 : 4 for column spacing, components handle own Grid item wrapping

DataTable.purpose: Reusable styled table components for consistent table styling across pages
DataTable.usage: Import specific styled components needed for table layouts - single source of truth for all table styling
components: StyledTableContainer - Main split-table wrapper with responsive design
StyledFixedTable - Fixed column table for name columns in split layouts
StyledScrollableTable - Scrollable table for data columns in split layouts
StyledScrollContainer - Horizontal scroll container for data overflow
StyledTableHeader - Themed header row with conditional rounded corners for split/regular tables
StyledTableRow - Row with alternating color support (not currently used)
StyledTableCell - Standard cell with theme spacing and conditional bottom border removal
DataTable.notes: Centralized table styling - feature-specific player/content styling should remain in feature directories. Supports both split-table layouts (roster) and regular table layouts (future)

FormStatusIndicator.purpose: Display form submission status (loading/success/error) - not for validation errors
FormStatusIndicator.usage: Use for submission feedback - validation errors shown inline via TextField helperText
FormStatusIndicator.notes: Shows loading spinner during submission, checkmark on success, error icon on failure. Inline field validation handled separately by TextField

useMediaQueries.purpose: Custom responsive hook that provides all theme breakpoints as boolean values
useMediaQueries.usage: Import and destructure needed breakpoints for conditional rendering and styling
useMediaQueries.notes: Preferred over MUI breakpoint utilities - provides consistent responsive logic across components

useLocalRateLimiting.purpose: Client-side rate limiting using localStorage to prevent form spam
useLocalRateLimiting.usage: Track form submissions by identifier (email) with configurable time windows and automatic cleanup

returnValues.checkRateLimit: Function to manually check rate limit
returnValues.recordAttempt: Function to record a submission attempt

useLocalRateLimiting.example: const { canSubmit, remainingAttempts, formattedTimeUntilReset, recordAttempt } = useLocalRateLimiting(email, 3, 60*60*1000);
useLocalRateLimiting.notes: Default: 3 attempts per hour. Automatically filters expired attempts. Updates countdown every minute.

useAuthenticatedForm.purpose: Firebase authentication check for protected forms
useAuthenticatedForm.usage: Monitor Firebase auth state and enforce authentication requirements - use for Contact/Register forms

returnValues.isAuthenticated: Boolean - whether user is logged in
returnValues.authError: Error message if auth required but user not logged in

useAuthenticatedForm.notes: Sets authError automatically if requireAuth=true and user not logged in. Unsubscribes on cleanup. Public forms (Sign In/Sign Up) should use requireAuth=false

useEmailService.purpose: Enhanced AWS SES email service with better error handling and state management
useEmailService.usage: Send emails via AWS SES Lambda function with proper loading/error states - used by useFormSubmission

returnValues.sendEmail: Async function to send email data
returnValues.error: Error object with message, status, data
returnValues.clearStatus: Function to clear error and response

useEmailService.example: const { sendEmail, loading, error, response, clearStatus } = useEmailService(process.env.REACT_APP_AWS_API_BASE_URL_DEV);
useEmailService.notes: Posts to ${apiBaseUrl}/contact/forms/submit. Enhanced error context with status codes and detailed messages. Use clearStatus to reset state.

useFormSubmission.purpose: Orchestrator hook combining auth, rate limiting, and email service for complete form management
useFormSubmission.usage: Primary hook for all AWS SES forms (Contact/Register) - provides unified interface with all protections

returnValues.handleSubmit: Main submission function with all checks (auth → rate limit → email)
returnValues.canSubmitForm: Boolean - whether form can be submitted
returnValues.clearAllStatus: Function to clear all status messages

useFormSubmission.example: const { handleSubmit, canSubmitForm, isLoading, error, showSuccessMessage, remainingAttempts } = useFormSubmission({ apiBaseUrl, requireAuth: true, rateLimitIdentifier: email, maxAttempts: 3, successDisplayDuration: 4000 });
useFormSubmission.notes: Executes checks in order: auth → rate limit → email submission. Auto-displays success message, records attempts, handles all errors. For public forms use requireAuth=false and rateLimitIdentifier=null

dataFetching.errorHandling: Query error boundaries and status checks

styling.methodology: Material-UI v5 with extensive custom theme
styling.responsive: useMediaQueries hook for conditional rendering - preferred over MUI breakpoint utilities
styling.theming: Custom palette with primary (#091F40), secondary (#4CBB17), comprehensive typography scale

forms.orchestration: useFormSubmission hook - combines auth, rate limiting, and email service for AWS SES forms

validation.method: Config-driven JSON files with React Hook Form rules (see contactUs.config.json pattern)
validation.timing: mode: 'onBlur' (validate when leaving field), reValidateMode: 'onChange' (re-validate as typing)
validation.display: Material UI TextField with error and helperText props from fieldState.error
validation.rules: Use React Hook Form built-in rules: required, minLength, maxLength, pattern, validate
validation.pattern: ALWAYS use fieldState.error from Controller render, NOT errors object from useForm (better performance)

submission.method: AWS SES via useFormSubmission orchestrator hook
submission.protection: Firebase auth required (Contact/Register) + client-side rate limiting (3 submissions/hour)
submission.flow: Auth check → Rate limit check → Send email → Record attempt → Show success (4s) → Clear form

authentication.protected: Contact and Register forms require Firebase auth (requireAuth: true)
authentication.public: Sign In and Sign Up forms are public (requireAuth: false)
authentication.check: useAuthenticatedForm hook monitors Firebase auth state

rateLimit.method: Client-side localStorage tracking via useLocalRateLimiting hook
rateLimit.display: MUI Alert showing remaining attempts and countdown (e.g., '2 submissions remaining', 'Try again in 45m')

errorDisplay.validation: Inline TextField helperText for field-level validation errors
errorDisplay.submission: FormStatusIndicator component for auth/rate limit/API errors
errorDisplay.pattern: Validation errors appear on blur, submission errors in banner above button

stateManagement.loading: Button disabled during submission (disabled={!canSubmitForm || isLoading}), CircularProgress in FormStatusIndicator
stateManagement.success: Auto-clear form using reset() callback, show success message for 4 seconds (configurable)
stateManagement.error: Inline validation errors + submission error banner + rate limit alert

bestPractices: Use Material UI TextField directly - avoid custom input wrapper components (over-engineering for simple forms)
Config-driven validation in JSON files - maintains separation of concerns
Spread {...field} in TextField instead of manual onChange/onBlur/ref passing
Use fieldState.error from Controller, NOT errors[name] from useForm (better performance, cleaner code)
Simple validation rules (minLength/maxLength) preferred over complex regex patterns
Use type='tel' for phone inputs (provides mobile numeric keyboard)
Use multiline prop for textarea, NOT type='textarea'
Use variant='outlined' for consistent TextField styling
For public forms: requireAuth=false, rateLimitIdentifier=null in useFormSubmission

layout.pageStructure: Hero (optional, full-width) + Container + Grid for main content
layout.contentGrid: Grid container with responsive columnSpacing using useMediaQueries
layout.sectionHeaders: SectionHeader as Grid item (xs=12) for SSR compatibility
layout.pagePattern: Navigation + Container + Grid > [SectionHeader + Feature Components as Grid items]
layout.sections: Always wrap major sections with SectionLayout within Grid items
layout.headers: Use SectionHeader for consistent section titles - place as dedicated Grid item
layout.spacing: Prefer TextBlock over manual div containers
layout.responsive: Use useMediaQueries for all conditional rendering and spacing

imports.order: MUI components first, React, then local components with // Comments grouping
imports.grouping: Group related imports with descriptive comments

javascript.style: Modern ES6+ syntax with React functional components
javascript.propTypes: Using PropTypes for type checking (not TypeScript)

imports.ordering: MUI first, React, then local components with comment grouping
imports.aliasing: Standard relative paths, no path aliases configured

functions.style: Arrow functions for components and utilities
functions.async: async/await with React Query for data fetching
functions.error: React Query error boundaries and status handling

responsive.approach: useMediaQueries hook for all responsive logic
responsive.rendering: Conditional rendering based on hook values
